g.text: LLMs need long contexts for many tasks
Large language models (LLMs) need to process long contexts to accomplish
many important tasks, such as long-document understanding [27], long-content
g.title: N1 [Context] (cites=3) Large language models (LLMs) need to process long contexts to accomplish many important tasks, such as long-document understanding [27], long-content creation [4], and long-term memorization/reasoning [41].

g.text: To address these needs, modern LLMs are built with extended context windows
(e.g., 128K) that enable remarkable long-context processing capabilities
g.title: N2 [Context] (cites=3) To address these needs, modern LLMs are built with extended context windows (e.g., 128K) that enable remarkable long-context processing capabilities [33; 39; 18].

g.text: Despite their effectiveness, LLMs encounter efficiency challenges in
g.title: N3 [Context] (cites=0) Despite their effectiveness, LLMs encounter efficiency challenges in processing long contexts.

g.text: On one hand, transformer-based LLMs incur substantial
computational costs due to the quadratic complexity of self
g.title: N4 [Context] (cites=0) On one hand, transformer-based LLMs incur substantial computational costs due to the quadratic complexity of self attention.

g.text: Large GPU memory for full KV cache
On the other hand, they require tremendous GPU memory to hold the
KV cache of the entire sequence for faster decoding.
g.title: N5 [Context] (cites=0) On the other hand, they require tremendous GPU memory to hold the KV cache of the entire sequence for faster decoding.

g.text: Both computation and memory costs increase as the context length grows.
g.title: N6 [Context] (cites=0) Both computation and memory costs increase as the context length grows.

g.text: Context compression is a promising direction
A wide array of studies are dedicated to alleviating efficiency issues,
among which context compression is a promising direction [32; 11; 20; 24;
g.title: N7 [Prior_Work] (cites=5) A wide array of studies are dedicated to alleviating efficiency issues, among which context compression is a promising direction [32; 11; 20; 24; 25].

g.text: Compress raw input into shorter representations
This approach aims to compress raw input into more concise representations,
allowing the generation process to be conditioned on a shorter context.
g.title: N8 [Prior_Work] (cites=0) This approach aims to compress raw input into more concise representations, allowing the generation process to be conditioned on a shorter context.

g.text: Cuts compute + memory; enables longer inputs
Therefore, it helps to reduce both computation cost of inference and memory
cost from KV cache, while also enabling the processing of longer inputs than
g.title: N9 [Prior_Work] (cites=0) Therefore, it helps to reduce both computation cost of inference and memory cost from KV cache, while also enabling the processing of longer inputs than the LLM's built-in context window.

g.text: Despite the current progresses, it it remains a tough challenge to compress
g.title: N10 [Limitation] (cites=0) Despite the current progresses, it it remains a tough challenge to compress long contexts.

g.text: Specifically, existing methods usually summarize the context into a few soft
tokens [11; 20], which constitute the major bottleneck to summarize the
g.title: N11 [Limitation] (cites=2) Specifically, existing methods usually summarize the context into a few soft tokens [11; 20], which constitute the major bottleneck to summarize the complex information within long contexts.

g.text: Besides, they try to compress the context "all-at-once", lacking a
fine-grained handling of the detailed information.
g.title: N12 [Limitation] (cites=0) Besides, they try to compress the context "all-at-once", lacking a fine-grained handling of the detailed information.

g.text: Soft tokens must be re-encoded → slow
Moreover, these soft tokens must be re-encoded before generation, resulting
in inferior efficiency in both training and inference.
g.title: N13 [Limitation] (cites=0) Moreover, these soft tokens must be re-encoded before generation, resulting in inferior efficiency in both training and inference.

g.text: Fixed soft-token count → no ratio control
Lastly, these methods are learned to compress with a fixed number of soft
tokens, thus, it's hard to customize the compression ratio for downstream
g.title: N14 [Limitation] (cites=0) Lastly, these methods are learned to compress with a fixed number of soft tokens, thus, it's hard to customize the compression ratio for downstream tasks.

g.text: While some alternamtive methods focus on deleting unimportant tokens [25;
31], they depend on the input question to estimate the token importance,
limiting their efficiency in real-world multi-turn scenarios.
g.title: N15 [Limitation] (cites=2) While some alternamtive methods focus on deleting unimportant tokens [25; 31], they depend on the input question to estimate the token importance, limiting their efficiency in real-world multi-turn scenarios.

g.text: To address the above challenges, we present Activation Beacon (Figure 1), a
plug-in module to transformer-based LLMs that enables effective, efficient,
and flexible compression of long contexts.
g.title: N16 [Method] (cites=0) To address the above challenges, we present Activation Beacon (Figure 1), a plug-in module to transformer-based LLMs that enables effective, efficient, and flexible compression of long contexts.

g.text: Activation Beacon is featured with the following technical designs.
g.title: N17 [Method] (cites=0) Activation Beacon is featured with the following technical designs.

g.text: First of all, we introduce a new special token, called the beacon token ⟨b⟩.
g.title: N18 [Method] (cites=0) First of all, we introduce a new special token, called the beacon token ⟨b⟩.

g.text: The context is distilled into beacon tokens' activations (i.e. keys and
values at every layer), whose capacity are large enough to encapsulate the
g.title: N19 [Method] (cites=0) The context is distilled into beacon tokens' activations (i.e. keys and values at every layer), whose capacity are large enough to encapsulate the complex information within long contexts.

g.text: Next, we tailor the compression workflow, where each fine-grained context
g.title: N20 [Method] (cites=0) Next, we tailor the compression workflow, where each fine-grained context unit is progressively compressed.

g.text: Specifically, the long context is partitioned into equal-size chunks.
g.title: N21 [Method] (cites=0) Specifically, the long context is partitioned into equal-size chunks.

g.text: Split chunks into units of size α
Each chunk is further split into fine-grained units of size α where α is the
g.title: N22 [Method] (cites=0) Each chunk is further split into fine-grained units of size α where α is the desired compression ratio.

g.text: A group of beacon tokens are interleaved with these units (one beacon token
is dispatched to the end of every unit).
g.title: N23 [Method] (cites=0) A group of beacon tokens are interleaved with these units (one beacon token is dispatched to the end of every unit).

g.text: The LLM encodes one chunk at a time, distilling the chunk's information into
beacon tokens' activations during self attention.
g.title: N24 [Method] (cites=0) The LLM encodes one chunk at a time, distilling the chunk's information into beacon tokens' activations during self attention.

g.text: Discard raw acts, accumulate beacon acts
After encoding, the raw tokens' activations are discarded; while the beacon
tokens' activations are accumulated and reused for encoding following
g.title: N25 [Method] (cites=0) After encoding, the raw tokens' activations are discarded; while the beacon tokens' activations are accumulated and reused for encoding following chunks.

g.text: This progressive workflow brings forth several advantages: 1) It can handle
inputs longer than the backbone LLM's context window as the chunk size is
small. 2) It achieves fine-grained compression since the attention scope of
g.title: N26 [Method] (cites=0) This progressive workflow brings forth several advantages: 1) It can handle inputs longer than the backbone LLM's context window as the chunk size is small. 2) It achieves fine-grained compression since the attention scope of each beacon token is differentiated. 3) By caching and reusing activations, it facilitates contiguous gradient propagation in training, avoids re-encoding overhead in inference, and allows for incrementally updating the compression results in multi-turn scenarios.

g.text: Finally, Activation Beacon is learned with compression-based auto-regression
to optimize the generation quality conditioned on the compressed context.
g.title: N27 [Method] (cites=0) Finally, Activation Beacon is learned with compression-based auto-regression to optimize the generation quality conditioned on the compressed context.

g.text: Thanks to high sample efficiency, the model can be effectively trained with
1B plain corpus and 30K fine-tuning samples (maximum context length is 20K),
g.title: N28 [Method] (cites=0) Thanks to high sample efficiency, the model can be effectively trained with 1B plain corpus and 30K fine-tuning samples (maximum context length is 20K), which can be quickly accomplished.

g.text: During training, we randomly sample the compression ratio for each chunk,
enhancing the model's flexibility to tackle different compression ratios in
g.title: N29 [Method] (cites=0) During training, we randomly sample the compression ratio for each chunk, enhancing the model's flexibility to tackle different compression ratios in downstream tasks.

g.text: Note that all beacon tokens share the same token embedding, one can use
arbitrary number of beacon tokens to achieve the desired compression ratio
g.title: N30 [Method] (cites=0) Note that all beacon tokens share the same token embedding, one can use arbitrary number of beacon tokens to achieve the desired compression ratio by repeating.

g.text: In our experiments, Activation Beacon is applied to Llama-2 [36] and Qwen-2
g.title: N31 [Result] (cites=2) In our experiments, Activation Beacon is applied to Llama-2 [36] and Qwen-2 [39].

g.text: We evaluate the resulted models on a variety of long-context tasks (whose
lengths may be much longer than the training length, e.g., 128K), such as
document understanding, few-shot learning, and Needle-in-a-Haystack.
g.title: N32 [Result] (cites=0) We evaluate the resulted models on a variety of long-context tasks (whose lengths may be much longer than the training length, e.g., 128K), such as document understanding, few-shot learning, and Needle-in-a-Haystack.

g.text: Whilst existing methods struggle to handle these challenging tasks,
Activation Beacon maintains a comparable performance to the uncompressed
baseline across various compression configurations, meanwhile achieving 2x
g.title: N33 [Result] (cites=0) Whilst existing methods struggle to handle these challenging tasks, Activation Beacon maintains a comparable performance to the uncompressed baseline across various compression configurations, meanwhile achieving 2x acceleration and 8x KV cache reduction.

g.text: Moreover, the LLM's original capabilities on short context is well
g.title: N34 [Result] (cites=0) Moreover, the LLM's original capabilities on short context is well preserved.
